Use these chapters for guided reading and self-checking alongside the slides
and selected lab/exercises. Earlier chapters are for revision; nothing in them
is collected or graded. The approved syllabus, workload guide and Blackboard
remain authoritative.

Read [How to use these companions](how-to-use.html) first. Week 11 is divided
into two linked meeting pages; its complete single-page version is also available.
